steps.step: As soon as the opening cutscene finishes, before moving Manny, open Options and turn on 'tank controls' for Movement Mode. This is required for the "The Right Way" trophy at the end of the game.
Grab the note by the window.
Walk over to the table and take the deck of cards.
Leave the office and walk down the hallway to Eva at reception.
Go through Eva's dialogue until "So what did you do in life to get stuck here?" appears. Select it, then finish the conversation.
?? Trophy — "What I did back in the fat days is none of your business. You know the rules" (B)
Walk around the desk and interact with the hole punch.
?? Trophy — "Gets the aggressions out, doesn't it" (B)
Take the left-hand lift down into the car park.
Go to the office in the far corner and knock on the door.

Speak to Glottis. Pick "Nice Hut" first and follow that dialogue branch until he says he needs to be breathing in the fumes. Continue through the remaining dialogue until Glottis gives you the work order.
?? Trophy — "It's like I'm not happy unless I'm breathing in the thick, black, nauseating fumes…" (B)
Go back to the elevator and take it to reception.
Speak to Eva and ask her to get the boss to sign the work order.
Go into the other elevator. When you get out, turn left and go through the big doors at the end to reach outside.
Walk around the building to the left and enter the alleyway, where you will see a rope hanging down.
Go into the window and investigate the boss's PC.
Change the auto response to "Ah cripes Eva, just sign it yourself will ya, I'm busy!"
Climb back out of the window, down the rope, and make your way back inside to reception.
Speak to Eva again and ask her to get the boss to sign the work order.
After the cutscene, save your game.
Go up to the 3 different people in the diner and interact with them. Each one will pull a different face and Manny will make a comment.
?? Trophy — "Scaring the living is technically against the rules, but we all do it". (B)
Use your scythe on the body bag to start a cutscene.
Once back at reception, go towards the hole punch, open your inventory, and use the deck of cards with the hole punch.
Take the elevator opposite back down to the lobby and walk towards the big doors leading outside.
After the big purple guy has finished moaning, head outside.
Go to Manny's left and run towards the tents and balloons.
Talk to the clown until you see "Bang!". Select it and finish the conversation. Do not pick "Twist me up one of them" yet, as this may lock you out of the trophy.
Ask the clown to make a cat for you.
Put it away and speak to him again. Ask for a dead worm.
Ask for another dead worm so you have 2 dead worms + 1 cat.
Ask the clown to make you Robert Frost.
Go to the stall next to the clown and pick up a stick of bread.
Head back into the lobby of the building you came out of and enter the door on Manny's right, which is now open.
Take out one dead worm and use it on the red tube.
Use the other dead worm on the blue tube.
Head back into the elevator and return to Manny's office.
Go to the back of the room and use both dead worms stuffed with chemicals in the message tube.
Go back to the elevator by reception and enter the room opposite the red and blue tube room. The purple guy will be working on the mail machine.
Walk up to him and go through the dialogue options until you can ask how he got in there.
?? Trophy — "I squeezed down one of these tubes, like a pixie!" (B)
Go through any other dialogue options you want. When you finish, Manny will automatically grab the fire extinguisher.
Interact with the door to lock the open door.
Leave the room so the maintenance guy thinks the door is secure.
Go back inside and enter the small room the purple guy was in.
Use your hole-punched playing card on the red tube to Manny's right to intercept a message and get a new client.
After the cutscene, talk with Meche and work through all dialogue options to find something she did that was bad. Continue until she says she could do something now if it helps.
?? Trophy — "Well, I could do something bad right now if that would help" (B)
Finish the conversation and exit your office.
Walk towards Eva in reception and be confronted by Don.
After the cutscene, you will be locked in Glottis' hut in the garage.
Knock on the door and work through the dialogue with the mysterious soul until you are taken to the Lost Souls Alliance hideout.
Once in control again, talk to Sal and ask if he knows something you don't.
Go through all of Sal's dialogue to receive a new task.
Speak to Eva and ask if she has any new messages for you, then work through the rest of the dialogue.
Exit the underground lair and climb the rope back up to the office.
Walk around the ledge to Dom's office and climb inside.
Go to his PC and guess the password. Repeat this 3 more times until Manny says "Arrogant fraud doesn't work."
Walk to the punch bag and hit it 3 times so a mouthguard drops to the floor.
Walk to the desk and open the drawer.
Pick up the chunk of coral inside.
Return to the window ledge and walk back to the rope.
Interact with the rope to pull it onto the ledge.
Use the chunk of coral with the rope to tie it to the end.
Throw the rope towards the ladder opposite you.
Climb the rope, follow the ledge to the ladder, and climb onto the roof.
Walk closer to the pigeons, take out your Robert Frost balloon, and use it on them until Manny says a phrase about running away.
?? Trophy — "Run you pigeons! It's Robert Frost!" (B)
On the roof, use the cat balloon on the bowl-shaped ventilation shaft.
Use the bread stick on the bowl to scare away the pigeons.
Go to where the pigeons were and steal the eggs.
Climb all the way back down the rope to ground level.
Enter the garage near where the rope meets the floor.
Go all the way to the back and enter Glottis' hut.
Use the blue mouthguard on the filling machine.
Have Manny bite the mouthguard to create an impression of his teeth.
Go back outside the garage and interact with the blue eye on the wall to return to the underground hideout.
Give the pigeon eggs to Sal.
Give the impression of your teeth to Eva to start a cutscene.
After arriving at the edge of the Petrified Forest, walk right to start a conversation with Glottis.
After Glottis throws his heart and the spiders take it, head north to where it landed in a spider web.
Walk up to the web and pick up a bone from the pile on the right.
Use the bone in the web.
Use your scythe on the web.
Pick up his heart and place it back inside his body.
After the cutscene, drive the car to the right to reach the tree farm.
When you regain control, walk straight up to Glottis and ask what is happening to the trees.
?? Trophy — "The marrow of these trees, Manny, they suck it out, it's like cement!" (B)
Use the wheelbarrow to block the 4 ground pipes and manipulate the pistons.
Synchronize the pistons so the 2 on the left move together, the 2 on the right move together, and the left/right pairs move opposite each other.
Confirm the machine begins shaking, indicating the synchronization is correct.
Pull the lever to the left so Glottis climbs to the top and adds weight.
Once Glottis reaches the top, hit the lever again.
Collect the new shocks after the machine comes spinning down.
Once back in the car, drive to the middle and get out.
Grab the sign in the bottom-right area.
Carry the sign through to the top-left area.
Place the signpost in the ground and follow the direction it points.
Move a little in that direction, place the sign again, and repeat until you discover the underground cave.
Go down the ramp and follow the path right.
Interact with the signpost in the bottom-right corner to get a key.
Leave the area and return to the car with Glottis.
Drive to the top-right exit and get out.
Walk towards the fence and go through the door. You will be sent back outside.
Go back through the door and approach the bones on the floor.
Get close enough to grab a bone without being chased off.
Walk down the left-hand path to the dirty pool of water.
Throw the bone into the water and immediately equip the fire extinguisher.
When the fire beaver walks to the lip above you and roars, use the fire extinguisher.
Time it so the beaver passes through the foam and is extinguished.
Collect another bone and repeat the process for the second fire beaver.
Repeat again for the third fire beaver.
Walk back outside and interact with the lock to the left of the door to start a cutscene.
When back in control, walk upstairs and follow the path to the diner.
Talk to Celso about everything, including asking him about work.
Exit the diner, go downstairs, and turn left into the foggy area.
Once back on dry land, speak with Velasco near Glottis.
Go through all of Velasco's dialogue until you can ask what is under his eye patch.
?? Trophy — "...Used to scream like a banshee when the trade wind blew..." (B)
Take out your photo and show it to Velasco to receive a log.
From the balcony, head inside to the office.
Go to the desk at the back and collect the note left by Sal.
After reading the message, open your inventory and select the note again.
While holding the note, keep interacting with it until you hear about the secret talents of the tiny messengers.
?? Trophy — "Great news - we've discovered a new, secret talent of our tiny messengers!" (B)
Go out the door and towards the camera until you reach the stairs where Glottis is playing piano.
Speak to Glottis about everything, including when you will eventually leave.
?? Trophy — "Plus, we look good in these clothes!" (B)
Go to the bar at the back of the room and collect the bottle of liquor.
Take a sip of the liquor.
Go back upstairs by Glottis and head towards the door on the left.
Talk to Lupe and go through all dialogue options, including asking about the coat-check system.
?? Trophy — "YOU'RE NOT EVEN LISTENING TO ME!!!" (B)
Make your way outside and downstairs to trigger a cutscene.
After the scene, walk to the end of the dock near Velasco.
Look at the moon. Pressing the interact button should produce "Don't have that kind of equipment."
While looking at the moon, use the poem/secondary action to recite a poem.
Exhaust all dialogue options with Velasco.
Head left and then north until you reach the Blue Casket restaurant.
Use the lift on the left side of the building.
Follow the path on the left upstairs back to the cafe.
Go back down to Glottis and enter the door at the back into the roulette room.
Speak to the man in the green suit and ask about everything, including counterfeit goods and passports.
?? Trophy — "We are all citizens of the same nation, and our king rides a pale horse". (B)
Make sure you receive the betting slip printer.
Make sure you receive the VIP pass.
Leave the roulette room, go back upstairs, and head outside.
Go downstairs and return to the elevator to the Blue Casket.
From the Blue Casket, go right to the round area with several paths.
Find the garage on the left and interact with the lever to its right to create a bridge.
Cross the bridge and go up the stone stairs.
Inside, go right to the large colorful cat display.
Go through the open door opposite the display.
Collect the tin of cat food directly to Manny's left.
Return through the display room and go upstairs.
Go through the door on the right.
Continue down the corridor. Manny will show his VIP pass and enter the elevator to the High Rollers Lounge.
Walk into the kitchen in the middle of the room for a short cutscene.
Pick up the turkey baster from the tray on the left.
Return after a few moments and look for the big green guy by the elevator on the right.
Speak to him about going down in the elevator.
?? Trophy — "Oh, yeah, I could take you down..." (B)
Leave the kitchen and go right into the large open area of the High Rollers Lounge.
Enter the dark doorway on the left and talk with Maximino.
?? Trophy — "Come to see how the big boys play, eh Manny?" (B)
Leave the High Rollers Lounge using the elevator and return all the way to the Blue Casket.
Enter through the main front doors.
Walk to the back of the room and meet Olivia.
Speak with Olivia, but do not encourage her to go on stage yet.
Return to the room and get on stage.
Interact with the microphone and recite a 4-line poem.
Walk back to Olivia and ask her to get on stage and read a poem.
Leave the Blue Casket and return to the round area with paths.
Go to the bottom and meet Terry the worker bee.
Speak with Terry about everything until he mentions being straight stingers.
Leave the bees and run back across the small bridge to the High Rollers VIP room.
Find Nick Virago sitting in the large room.
Tell Nick you need a lawyer.
?? Trophy — "So, sorry, but I don't do... 'odd jobs'." (B)
Tell him you need a lawyer or you will tell Max about his love affair.
After Nick leaves, collect his cigarette case from the table.
Leave the VIP lounge and enter the elevator.
Once back at the stairs, go upstairs to meet Carla at security.
Go through the dialogue until she thinks it is a bomb and you receive a key.
Run all the way back to Terry and the worker bees.
Continue straight past them to the lighthouse.
Use the new key on the lighthouse and go inside.
After the cutscene, return to the Blue Casket.
Enter the elevator on the left and follow the stairs back to the cafe.
Give the coat tile from Lola to Lupe.
Take the coat Lupe brings you.
Inspect the coat from your inventory to get a slip of paper.
Take the slip of paper downstairs to Glottis at the piano.
Exit the cafe. Lupe may stop you on the way out.
Return to the elevator and take it down to the Blue Casket.
Return to the VIP lounge, now occupied by Glottis.
Enter the kitchen and wait for the waiter.
When the waiter enters the wine cellar, quickly close the doors behind him.
Use your scythe to keep the waiter locked inside.
After the scene, climb the wooden ladder.
Use the tin opener on the keg.
Climb inside the opened keg to trigger the next scene.
You will be in the basement. Get on the forklift truck and drive forwards into the lift.
Park up facing the exit near the red button.

Hop off the forklift truck and press the red button. Quickly get back on the forklift truck and drive it forwards so that the prongs go through the right hand gap at the bottom of the fence and make the elevator halt.
Get off the forklift truck again and go around to the other side of it to pull the lever near the prongs.
Leave the elevator and walk down the long corridor to the end. Pick up the suitcase you see on Manny's left.
From here you should make your way back down the stairs, outside and back to the round area with paths shooting off from it.
From there head north again to the Blue Casket.
Go to the back, and through the doors to the left or the area, into the kitchen.
After the short scene, use the turkey baster in your inventory on the dirty sink to fill it up.
Leave the Blue Casket and go back to the round area with paths shooting off from it.
Go south and before you cross the small bridge to the cat track you will see a train track on the floor.
At the end of the pier keep walking and you will go down some short stairs to a new area. Enter the building at the end to see a tattooist.
Walk around the tattooist and open up his fridge, then interact with the drawer inside the fridge.

Walk back around Naranja to where he is taking sips from a drink on the side. When he is looking away, use the turkey baster with horrible liquid in it on his drink bottle. This took me a few tries with timing, but you will get there eventually.
Once Naranja is knocked out, take the dog tags from his sleeping body.
Leave this area and go back to the race track building across the small bridge, to the right of the garage. Go upstairs to the security area.
Take out the gold flecked bottle of booze and take another sip.
Try to walk through the metal detector.

When you are in the back room and Carla is talking to you, do not choose any of the dialogue options until the end when Carla starts crying. Then if you choose the option about letting you hold the metal detector while she is crying, it will unlock the next dialogue trophy.
Trophy: "Here, let me hold that metal detector for you while you cry…" (B) Unlocked.
Go down from security, then down again until you see the people at the race track. Go to the right hand side, this is where the big cat display is.
Go through the door on the right to where the giant cat food tins are.
Walk out on to the metal walkway in the centre and whip out your scythe.

When you hear a beeping noise reach its loudest, you should be near enough to use your scythe to hook up the metal detector. If you don’t want to use the sound to locate it, a couple of minutes trial and error and you will get it.
Leave this area and go back to the round area with the paths shooting off from it. Head to the Blue Casket, and get in the lift to the left hand side.
Instead of going up the stairs to the left, go straight down the steps.

In this new area, go straight down the stairs and immediately left and through the blue/green doors to meet Membrillo the Mortician. Talk to him about why he is still here to unlock the next dialogue trophy.
Trophy "Manny, we've given up. All of us". (B) Unlocked.
Throw the dog tags in your inventory on to the corpse to the left, then hand Membrillo your metal detector.
Wait until Membrillo makes a call to the guy at the docks then leave this area, and head back to the Blue Casket by going down the elevator.
In the main bar area you will see 3 people sitting at a table with a red book on it, in the bottom right of the room.
Approach these and show them the letter from Sal that you have. Now ask them for the red book on the table and they will gladly let you have it.
Leave the Blue Casket and head over to the area where the Bees are. Give them the red book you have just picked up to start a cutscene.
After the scene head back to Toto the tattooists, where you got the dog tags off Naranja and hand the scrap of paper you have been holding to Toto who will be on the phone.
Use your ticket printing machine that you have been carrying and create a ticket for Week 2, Tuesday, Race 6.

Go back to the racetrack and go up the stairs. Go up again until you reach the point where you can carry on to security or go right to the VIP lounge. Walk around to the right to the balcony, then keep going right to get to the booth. Take out your betting ticket and interact with the booth to call the attendant out.
Go back around the stairs and take the corridor to the VIP lounge. Virago will be sitting at one of the tables again.
Show him the picture you have just received from the ticket booth.
After the scene ends, head back to the elevator to get to the Blue Casket, then follow the path over to where the Bees are.

They will be chanting a song, all you have to do is press :cross: in time and chant along all the way through. If you are in time, they will start chanting about Manny, keep chanting with them and you will unlock the next trophy.
Head over to the elevator next to the Blue Casket and go all the way back to Manny's cafe.
Once inside, go up the stairs to the right of reception back to Manny's office.
Interact with the desk to reveal the roulette board.
You will see a wheel on the left hand side of the board. When you see the furthest right light come on, operate the magnet to start another cutscene.
This will finish year 2 and begin your 3rd year.
Once you're in control of Manny on the boat, go inside and down the ladder on the left hand side.
Walk down the corridor and you will end up in a small room with Glottis.
Use the red buttons on the sides of the room to raise the anchors.
Now drop the left hand side anchor by pressing the red button on the left again.
Go over to the levers on the left of the room and interact with them. Choose the right arrow to move the ship.
Exit and go over to the red button on the right hand side and drop the right anchor.
Press it again to lift up the anchor, which will have caught the other sides anchor as well.

You may have to use the opposite arrow to move the ship, depending on where it starts but the idea is quite simple, drop one sides anchor, move the boat to the other side then drop the opposite anchor so they cross and you can lift them with the second anchor.
Go to the round window and use your scythe on the anchors to link it over the window.
Go to the left hand side red button and press it to draw in the anchor.
Go to the levers and press it down to break away from the other half of the boat for a cutscene.
Walk towards the light to get a warning from Glottis, then wait around until you see a creature with a light walks by.
Start talking to him when he comes close and talk to him about everything, especially asking him how long he has been down there. This will unlock your next dialogue trophy.
Trophy "I wasn't always this color!" (B) Unlocked.
Let him carry on his loop after talking to him. When he is at the right hand side, grab his light, then turn and interact with Glottis so he will pick him up.

In the next area, head to the far right to see a rock sticking up with some tendrils flowing out of it. Walk around the right hand side and Chepito will follow and get stuck, allowing you to move on to the next area.
When you arrive, head straight forward into an elevator. Once you reach the top, go to the right and follow the path for a cutscene with Meche.
You will wake up next to a cage with 2 little people in it.
Speak to them and tell them you will sue their parents to unlock another dialogue trophy.
Finish all the dialogue options to get one of the kids to throw a hammer on the floor.
Pick up the hammer, then make you way back to Meche's office.
Talk to Meche and try to explain things to her, she will reply with "save your breath", unlocking the next dialogue trophy.

Now you need to interact with the ashtray at the right time so that Meche flicks her cigarette onto her stockings. Keep interacting with the ashtray as different times and you will get it right by trial and error after a couple of tries.
Pick her stockings up from the bin then leave the office back to the elevator.
Once you get out of the lift go to the bottom left of the area to see Chepito at the bottom.
Go through all the dialogue and ask him about trading booty, eventually you will get him to talk about his bust-all, which will unlock the next dialogue trophy.
Give him the hammer you picked up and then give him the stockings and you will receive some items in exchange.
Head back to the lift area and go towards to 2 lights over on the right hand side to lead to a new area with a conveyor belt.
Pull the lever to change the direction of the belt and the jump up on to it. Run up the belt above the water to the left.
Go up the stairs on the left to gain control of the crane. Move the crane to the other side of the island.
Lower the crane to see a new area.
Run down on to the beach and use you bust-all on the large chain.
Go back up the stairs to take control of the crane again and lower the chain into the grinder below, then lift it back up again.
Move the crane back round again to the other side of the island and lower the chain so it lands on the conveyor belt.
Get off the crane and run back down the conveyor belt and jump off near the lever.
Pull the lever to change direction of the belt, this will pull the chain down.
Pull the lever again to bunch the chain up, then again so it catches on the anchor.
Jump back on the conveyor belt and run up it to the crane. Pull the chain up to bring Glottis and the boat back up to the surface.
Get back on the crane and move it round the island, then run down the belt and jump off near the lever.
Go back to the elevator and take it up, then go back to Meche. Go past her into Dom's office.
Talk to him about everything, including asking about his plan. This will unlock the next dialogue trophy.
Trophy: "Okay, how much of the haven't you figured out, Calavera?" (S) Unlocked.
Go back to Meche and use your gun on her.
Once the cutscene ends, leave the offices and in the corridor you will see a door with a wheel and you will hear Meche shouting.
Use the bust-all on the right side of the door to see the next puzzle.

The idea here is to spin the bolts so that it leaves a clear gap between them and the edge. You have to alternate spinning them left and right to get them to line up. Once they have been lined up, use your scythe the fit between them and use the door handle to open it up.
Once you are inside, shut the door behind you and use your scythe on the gold pipe at the top of the door.
Go through into the next room and use your scythe on the sprinkler in the middle of the ceiling.
Next use the small wheel on the right hand side to drain the water, and keep an eye on what tile the water drains through.
Go back through to the first room and run over to the left. You will see a massive axe on the floor, pick it up and drag it over to the tile that the water drained out of near Meche.
Interact with the axe over the tile to create a hole you can climb out of.
After the cutscene, take out your scythe and use it on Domino. Keep doing this until the trophy pops. It must have taken me nearly 10 times before it popped.
Trophy: "Stop showing off for the girl!" (B) Unlocked.
Use your scythe on the sea monsters eye to start the next cutscene and also net you the trophy for the end of Year 3.
Walk down all the stairs to find a coffin at the bottom. Open it up to find Bruno, who will give you a mug and this should net your next dialogue trophy without having to do anything.
Trophy: "I'm getting out of here. This world's for suckers". (B) Unlocked.
Go back up the stairs to start a cutscene.
After the scene, go inside the train station and move forward to find Chepito running round in circles in a fountain.
Talk to Chepito and it will start a conversation that will unlock your next trophy.
Now attempt to follow the same path that Chepito took, to make Manny speak and unlock another trophy.
Trophy: "I could walk out of this world and not look back…" (B) Unlocked.
Leave the train station and attempt to go down the stairs. The gatekeeper above the door will give you a note from Hector.
Go halfway down the stairs and go to the right hand side area to find Glottis.

Do not speak to Glottis.  Ensure you are speaking to the little blue gremlins and go through all the dialogue with them and they will come out with the comment about him being large. This will unlock the next dialogue trophy.
Go down the stairs on the right and enter the small doorway to the kitchen.
Put to mug in your inventory on to the mug stand next to the sink.
Now open the right hand drawer and take a rag.
Take the rag outside the kitchen and use it with the red cannister to the side of the doorway to make it oily.
Go back inside the kitchen and use the oily rag with the toaster to start a cutscene.
Once you are back in control of Manny, back out of the garage and go back to the round area with paths shooting off it.
Go left to where the bees used to be, and carry on past it to the lighthouse.
Enter the lighthouse and run around the top to have Manny remember Lola and unlock the next trophy.
Go back to the round area and head right to the docks to speak to Velasco.
Take the bottle where he was sitting, then head back to the round area and north to the Blue Casket.
Go to the back and enter the kitchen. Fill your empty bottle with the liquid from the large keg sat on the side.
Leave the kitchen and knock on the door to the right of the kitchen to speak with Olivia.
Leave the Blue Casket and walk back to the garage where Glottis and Meche are.
Give Glottis the bottle of drink you just made to make him feel ill. Speak to him after to make him throw up.
Follow the train tracks south to get to Toto’s tattoo cabin.
On the right hand wall there is a medicine cabinet, open it up to get the liquid nitrogen.
Go back to the garage where Glottis is and use the liquid nitrogen on the gelatin on the floor to freeze it.
Make sure you do the next step before disabling the bomb.
Go over to the back of the bone wagon and press :square: to unlock the next trophy.
Disable the bomb to start a cutscene.
When you are in control of Manny again, interact with the radio microphone on the desk to unlock your next trophy.
Pick up the arm of the guy who just got sprouted, then talk to Meche in the corner.
Leave the room, go past Glottis and climb the ladder on the wall.
Climb the ladder at the back of this area as well to reach the backstage of the casino.
Grab the coffee pot from the table, and then walk over to the ladder to the left of the performers. You will have to interact with it to get to the top.
Pour the coffee on to the performers heads to make them leave, then climb back down the ladder.
Put the coffee pot back on its stand, then go into the door on the right to get changed for the show.
It's worth making a save now in case this bit goes wrong.

Go back up the stairs then climb the ladder to the left and take out the bone hand from your inventory, then interact with the snow grinder to the left. If you use the snow grinder without the bone hand it will glitch and you won’t be able to pick the grinder up and have to reload a save.
You should have a hand held bone grinder at the end of it.
Go back down the ladder, then down the other ladder again.
Go down to the slot machines, and speak with the guy in the raincoat in the corner 3 times.
Talk to Meche a couple of times until she recognises you and give you the sheet.
Throw the sheet over Charlie, then speak to the agent in the raincoat to hack the machine he was playing on.
Walk in the bathroom to finish your disguise.
Leave the casino by the door to the right of the bathroom, and go back down the ladders to the LSA headquarters where you reunited with Sal.
Search the bin by the door to find a photo.
Next use the note from Hector with the pigeon on the back shelf, then give the pigeon the photo you just picked up to start a cutscene.
Once the scene finishes, leave the room and go forward until you see Glottis and the bone wagon. Go to the top right of the area to go into a new area.
Follow the path round to the right until Manny says he doesn’t want to go into the maze, then use the bone grinder to start the next area.
As the alligator is walking towards you open up your inventory and use the hydraulic jack device to raise the bone wagon.
Move forward, then exit the bone wagon on to the ledge on the right.

Start to climb down the ladder so that the alligator turns around. Once he is facing you, climb back up the ladder and use the remote hydraulic device to bring the bone wagon down on the alligators tail.
Climb back down the ladder and walk to the right. Enter the florist and use your Scythe on the bell above the door.
Exit the florist, then go back inside to get a gun.
You will find yourself back at the sewers, climb the ladder then enter the casino.
Talk to the purple guy guarding the lift. To get in you have to answer a simple question, the answer will be the last number that shows up on the big board behind Manny.
Once inside, go through all the dialogue options with Celso and his wife to get them to agree to Hectors offer. Try to follow them to start a cutscene.
Walk along the ledge until you see a ladder, try to climb up it.
Get back on the ledge and look at the support beam for the sign and notice the crack in it. Use your bone grinder on the crack, and then your tin of sproutella to open up the path.
Climb the ladder for another cutscene.
Run up the hill and enter the greenhouse at the top for another cutscene.
Use the liquid nitrogen from your inventory once you are laying on the ground to stop the sprouting.

Phase one: compose your team so you have one member who can use nuke, psi, curse, or bless attacks; one who can use fire, ice, electric, or wind attacks; and two who can use a high-damage, single-target physical skill. Violet and Joker are the two best candidates for the physical roles.
Hit each of the three tentacles with their respective weaknesses, using Baton Pass until your fourth team member can hit the boss’s persona with the Baton Pass boost.

Phase two: certain skills or abilities will be blocked. The boss starts by blocking magic attacks and then rotates restrictions including physical attacks, Baton Passes, recovery, defending, and support skills.
When recovery is blocked, defend until the restriction changes. The boss can also target a party member with a powerful almighty attack.

When the persona’s HP drops below 50%, it gains a two-turn charge attack that deals extremely powerful almighty damage to everyone. This phase ends when either the boss or persona reaches 0 HP; focusing on the boss avoids the persona’s charged attack.
Phase three: stay alive until Oracle finds the weak spot. Focus on blocking and healing rather than attacking. Maria makes this easier.
Phase four will be self-explanatory once you get there.
Once you're finished the fight, enjoy the cutscenes and the true ending.

Direct your companions to assist in combat 10 times each
You must be assisted by your first story companion Bode 10 times ( r1 + square ). You can only do this in Chapter 1 and Chapter 4. If missed, it can quickly be done in New Game+
Defeat 50 enemies under the effect of Slow
Hit 3 enemies with a single roller mine

This is slightly more annoying than it sounds, as roller mines track relentlessly towards you like a magnet before exploding. You’ll need to first find a cluster of three or more enemies, then Force Pull a roller mine towards you, before pushing it back towards your targets. You’ll have to do it quickly, though, or you’ll get a face-full of exploding roller mine. Bagging two enemies is easy, but getting three can be a pain.  Try using the Wrenching Pull ability to draw as many enemies as you can into one place, then throw a roller mine their way. There are multiple places to try this, but bear in mind that roller mines will follow you until they blow up, so use that to your advantage. They’ll also respawn after you rest at a Meditation Point, so you can keep trying when you find an ideal spot.

During the story, you’ll eventually acquire the ability to Lift and Slam enemies using the Force. To Lift, hold R1 and triangle. Initially, you can only do this to smaller foes, but if you pour Skill Points into this ability, you can Lift larger enemies. Simply Lift an enemy and attack them, performing this 20 times to unlock the trophy. You might have to jump a bit to reach them while they’re suspended in mid-air, or you can use Cal’s blaster.

Focus Sight can be purchased from the Resilience Skill Tree (under Survival). To evade incoming attacks, you’ll then need to hold down the circle button, causing Cal to automatically bob and weave. The manoeuvre will cost a chunk of your Force gauge, so make sure you have a full metre before executing this. If you unlock this early, you should be able to avoid 50 attacks with little effort.

You’ll find this ability in the Dual-Wielded Lightsaber Skill Tree - once acquired, you’ll be able to hold down triangle when using this Stance to have Cal put the lightsaber in front of him using the Force. Keep the button held until the moment an enemy attacks you, then let go. If you get the timing right, Cal will hit back with an automatic counterattack, denoting that you’ve successfully executed a precision release. Do this ten times to unlock the trophy.
Slam 5 enemies with a single use of Slam

Once you’ve reached a certain point in the story, you’ll unlock the Slam ability. You’ll then need to save up some Skill Points to acquire ‘Mass Slam’ in the Telekinesis skill tree, enabling you to Lift several enemies at once. Once you’ve purchased Mass Slam, use Lift (R1 + triangle) to raise five enemies, then Slam them down into the ground (R1 + cross). Any of the many story battles with lots of regular Stormtroopers or B1 Battle Droids is the best place for this. For example, in Chapter 5, when you enter the hangar with the TIE Fighters on your way to the Observatory, is a great place for this because the room will be teeming with basic Stormtroopers.
Reach the highest point of Harvest Ridge

Harvest Ridge is a territory found in the Rambler’s Reach region on Koboh. You can find it north of the Cantina and is marked by an easily distinguished tower. You will have to climb this tower to unlock the trophy. However, getting to it is not so obvious. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to do it:

In Harvest Ridge territory is a red barn (map screenshot below). Get to it and to the side of the barn you will find three Nekkos, one of the rideable creatures in the game. Mount one Nekko and use it to jump above the entrance to the barn where you can find a metal sheet you can wall-run on. This will get you to the top of the barn where you can find an opening you can use Pull on to get inside.
Once inside you can find a chain contraption you can use Pull on in one of the corners. This will raise the barn’s gate. While the barn’s gate is open, press r1 to call up a Nekko.
Let go of the chain and use the Nekko to reach a higher corner platform. Atop this platform, use Pull on the chain once more and slot it in place.
Drop down and ride a second Nekko inside the barn.
Go back to the platform and remove the chain from the slot, thus lowering the lift inside the barn.
Place one Nekko at the side of the lift closest to the overhead exit (the one you entered the barn from) and leave it there.
Now return to the higher platform and slot the chain once more.
You can now exit the barn with the Nekko you placed on the lift, thus giving you access to the base of the tower and allowing you to climb it.
Help lift a ship out of the tar pits

On your way to the Cantina during Chapter 2, when passing through Gorge Crash Site you will spot a Pit Droid whose ship is stuck in a tar pit. Return later in the game once you learn the Lift ability in Chapter 4 and press r1 and triangle to raise the ship out of the tar and unlock this trophy. Talk to the Pit Droid afterwards to recruit him to the Cantina for bronze Max Capacity.
Drop your mount into the great unknown

This is best done on Jedha. Fast travel to the Anchorite Base Meditation Point and mount one of the Spamels next to it. Now ride to the opposite cliff and dismount it a moment before dropping it to unlock the trophy. The trophy may unlock with some delay or not at all. In the latter case, try traveling away from and back to the Anchorite Base or reboot your game.
Train with your weapons while wearing a headband

You can pick up the headband from Doma’s store on Koboh (the blue door opposite Pyloon’s Saloon) in exchange for Priorite Shards. Buy it and equip it via the customisation menu, then, travel to Jedha and hit the Stormtrooper dummy near where the Mantis lands.

steps.step: On Koboh, head towards the Fort Kah’lin meditation spot, then grapple up to the upper level, and follow it around until you find a load of droids on a landing platform, next to a Priorite Shard. Walking towards the shard will see the ground crumble beneath you, dropping into a boss fight with the Spawn of Oggdo. This throwback to the infamous Oggdo Boggdo boss fight from Fallen Order is tough, but defeating him allows you to open the crate in its pit to acquire the Poncho. Equip it in the customisation menu to unlock the trophy
Dropkick an enemy while wearing a mullet

To obtain the Mullet, you need to find it in a chest in the Derelict Dam region of Koboh. You can only obtain this when you get the Slam power in Chapter 4. From the Meditation Point, go forwards and cross the tar pit and climb up the vines. To the left, opposite the huge creature, is a yellow platform which you can lower with Slam (press r1 and cross . Climb up, then go forwards and jump across to the floating yellow barge and kill the droids. Go to the back of it and drop down to the platform with an Echo and a chest which contains the Mullet. Equip it in the customization menu. To perform a dropkick, equip the Crossguard Stance from any Meditation Point and then run towards any enemy while holding square .
Fill the aquarium in the cantina

You can start working on this upon picking up a Rumor pertaining to a mysterious fisherman. It’s Skoova, and you can find him in the Foothill Falls region on Koboh. Talk to him, and you’ll complete the Rumor, recruiting him for Pyloon’s Saloon, where he’ll look after your fish tank. You’ll also subsequently find Skoova in various locations, where talking to him will prompt him to dive and throw up a new fish to add to your aquarium. There are 12 fish to track down in total.
Snakefish (Jedha > Anchorite Base): Found right of the Meditation Point.

Faintailed Laa (Jedha > Crypt of Uhrma): From the Crypt of Uhrma meditation point, go up the stairs and up the stairs again. Now through the door and jump-dash across the chasm on the right. Continue on and then downhill to enter the Crypt of Uhrma. Inside the Crypt, you’ll find a puzzle door. Number the switches in the first row 1-4, and the ones in the second row 5-8. Pull 1-4-6-7. Enter the secret area and you’ll eventually find Skoova.

Big Mouth Faa (Koboh > Rift Passage): After defeating the boss at the top of the Observatory as part of Chapter 5, use the elevators to reach a cavern. From here, zip-line to the bottom and in the next room you’ll find Skoova. Talk to him and when he’s done talking, he’ll catch the fish for you.
See Fish (Koboh > Foothill Falls): Located in the pond where you meet Skoova for the first time.
Frilled Newt (Koboh > Gorge Crash Site): Right near the Meditation Point.
Barbed Hookfish (Koboh > Smuggler’s Tunnel): Dive into the water below and you’ll see Skoova’s fishing boat.
Fingerlip Garpon (Koboh > Rambler’s Reach Outpost): Behind the house closest to the stables, edge of the water.

Viscid Lurker (Koboh > Phon’Qi Caverns): After you meet Prince Patren for the first time and jump down the ledges with all of the puffer acid enemies and kamikaze grenade B1 Battle Droids, you’ll see Skoova below you next to a small pool.
Mee (Koboh > Mountain Ascent): Phase through both the green laser gates, then keep looking to the right and you should see a bridge and a ledge you can jump down to. Skoova is on here.
Glottsamcrab (Koboh > Viscid Bog): Right next to the tent with the Rumor icon, found near the Meditation Point.
Blue-Finned Crayfish (Koboh > Nekko Pools): Head to the Meditation Point and ride a Nekko uphill towards the Bygone Settlement territory. You’ll find Skoova as soon as you reach the border with it.

Blinding Rayfish (Koboh > Devastated Settlement): Found atop one of the pillars in the Devastated Settlement. If you go to the Grand Court meditation point, it’s the closest one to that. You can get here by gliding with the Relter. It’s the only spire with a small pond atop it.
Find space for a full garden

Across Koboh, you’ll find various plant life surrounded by glowing green insects. Cutting through these with Cal’s lightsaber will yield seeds, which can then be planted in the rooftop garden at Pyloon’s Saloon. Recruiting Pili in the Blustery Mesa region of Jedha will enable you to learn more about what you’ve planted, and she’ll help you clear more space to grow stuff. There are ten varieties of Koboh Seed to be grown, and you’ll need to plant them all to unlock this. The ten different Koboh Seeds are the Tuber Maw, Pine Fern, Koboh Spiker, Spine Fluff, Palm Fruit Shell, Fire Pineapple, Cactus Ball, Bluebell Squish, Crimson Jelly Spire, and Goldenlight Moss.

Tuber Maw (Koboh > Southern Ridge): continue up the hill. Start going down the hill on your left and you’ll eventually come across a barn building on your right. Go behind it and you’ll find it near the red and green painted silo.
Palm Fruit Shell (Koboh > Harvest Ridge): this is found in the heart of Harvest Ridge where the big grate on the ground is, especially on the ridges above.
Koboh Spiker (Koboh > Summit Ridge): use the orange balloon near the Meditation Point and you will find it on your left when you land.
Spine Fluff (Koboh > Southern Reach): from the Meditation Point, go uphill and fly the Relter to the stone island at the bottom of Southern Ridge. Open the map to see it if needed.

Pine Fern (Koboh > Hunter’s Quarry): from the Rambler’s Reach Outpost meditation point, climb up the vine. As soon as you get to the top, point your camera to the right to see a yellow facade encased in the cliff side. Go towards it. You’ll find the plant in your path. You’ll find more of the same seed all across Hunter’s Quarry.
Fire Pineapple (Koboh > Gorge Crash Site): found near the Meditation Point, next to the elevator.

Goldenlight Moss (Koboh > Rambler’s Reach Outpost): from the Meditation Point, continue through the outpost and past the stables and make your way to Swindler’s Wash. As soon as you run on the wall and up onto the ledge, turn right and walk across the marshes. Then, jump across the gap you just came from and you’ll find it. You’ll find more of the same seed all across Swindler’s Wash.
Bluebell Squish (Koboh > Southern Reach): from the Meditation Point, continue up the hill. Start going down the hill on your left and you’ll find it immediately after, opposite the Relter.
Cactus Ball (Koboh > Gorge Crash Site): found near the Meditation Point.
Crimson Jelly Spire (Koboh > Devastated Settlement): from the Meditation Point, drop down to the ledge on your left.

Doma’s Shop is found on Koboh and it unlocks in Chapter 2 after rescuing Zee from the Jedi Chamber of Duality and returning to the Cantina. Doma’s Shop can be found to the left of the Cantina when facing it. To access Doma’s Shop, interact with the trinket on the table. To be able to make purchases you have to own the required amount of Priorite Shards, a collectible loot that can be found all throughout Koboh and Coruscant or obtained from killing Scavenger Droids.

To buy everything the Shop has to offer you need a total of 100 Priorite Shards. In short, you need to find all Priorite Shards and the best way to go about it is to first unlock the Map Upgrade that populates all planets’ maps with Treasure – see All Map Upgrades. This can be found in the center of Jedha > Arid Flats. There in the middle sits an area called Wayfinder’s Tomb. To access it, you need to solve three environmental puzzles found across Arid Flats and in their specific areas. These are Path of Conviction, Path of Persistence, and Path of Restoration (all shown on the Holomap and found at the edges of Arid Flats). Solving these puzzles opens the tomb, giving you access to the first map. This Map Upgrade populates all planets with the locations of Treasures (Priorite Shards, Data Discs, and Jedha Scrolls).

After fully exploring all planets, it’s very likely that you’ll be on 99/100 Priorite Shards. The last one is much trickier than the others; the map shows an icon at the stables in Rambler’s Reach Outpost but it isn’t visible anywhere. To get it, you need to stable a Nekko in the stall to the right of the entrance, but it has to be a brightly coloured Nekko (either purple, pink or red). You might be lucky and see one of these roaming around near the stables, but if not then fast travel to Bygone Settlement and jump down from the ledge you’re on and there should be a purple one there. If not, you’ll soon come across one in this small area. Then travel back to the stable, dismount with :r3: and rest at a Meditation Point. Come back and the Nekko will have pooped out the Shard, which you can pull out of the pile of dung with the Force Lift ability once you earn it from the story.

Skill Trees come under three main categories - Resilience, Lightsaber, and Force. There is one Survival Skill Tree (Resilience), five Lightsaber trees (Single, Double-Bladed, Dual Wield, Blaster, and Crossguard), and three Force trees (Jedi Concentration, Telekinesis, and Confusion), and you’ll need to completely max out any three of the Skill Trees. You’ll earn a Skill Point each time you fill the XP bar, and you can then spend them at any Meditation Point. Simply pour any earned Skill Points into purchasing skills, and you’ll soon unlock this.

Force Tears are glowing purple anomalies you’ll find in certain hidden spots. They’re normally well tucked away, and entering them will present you with either a tricky combat challenge or some sort of gauntlet to traverse using Cal’s acrobatic platforming skills. Some you’ll breeze through with little effort, while others will drive you to despair. You can keep on retrying each Force Tear challenge, or leave and come back later. Generally speaking, combat-based Force Tears are more straightforward, whereas traversal-based Force Tear challenges require very precise wallrunning, jumping, dashing, and so on. Perseverance is key - keep on trying until you get them done, even if it reduces you to (Force) tears.

Koboh - Fractured Burden: From the Gorge Crash Site meditation point, step on the elevator and immediately step off it to reveal a liftable plate. Drop down for the Tear. Defeat the three large enemies.

Koboh - Fractured Agility: To access this Tear you have to go to Boiling Bluff. Interact with the orange balloon dispenser and place one so you can reach the other two. Then, make your way to the platform the balloons lead you to and interact with the beast. It will teleport you right on a higher platform on Derelict Dam with the Tear you wouldn’t have been able to reach previously. Now complete the platforming challenge.

Koboh - Fractured Momentum: In the Smuggler’s Tunnel, if coming from the Cantina entrance, go through the first green laser gate and in the distance you’ll see a second one. Wall run and phase through it to find this Tear, which is a platforming challenge.

Koboh - Fractured Delusion: Located in Hunter’s Quarry. Use the grappling point to climb up the vines behind Doma’s shop, then use the floating weather instruments with your ascension hook to the wall run panel and step inside the cave to find this. Defeat the enemies. It should be noted that this Force Tear may not be necessary for the trophy and you may already have unlocked it if this is your last one. If you can’t see the Force Tear at the location, you need to first access the building near Doma’s Shop. Inside it is an enemy type which you then can find inside the Force Tear, thus unlocking it.
Koboh - Fractured Duality: On the Cantina’s rooftop garden, climb the tower via the vines. You have to defeat the enemies using the Double-Bladed Stance.

Koboh - Fractured History: First, you have to kill Spawn of Oggdo at Fort Kah’Lin. See Star Wars Jedi: Survivor All Legendary Adversary Locations. Then, go to Doma’s Shop and interact with the miniature Oggdo next to her and it will spawn this Tear. You have to defeat two more Spawns of Oggdo.
Koboh - Fractured Resolve: Behind the first waterfall. Complete the platforming sequence. You can easily get to this location once your way to the Forest Array region as part of Chapter 2.

Koboh - Fractured Punishment: This Force Tear can be found in the Stone Spires region. You will automatically reach this region halfway through Chapter 3. After unlocking the three updrafts, use the Renter near the Devastated Settlement meditation point to reach and fly through them counterclockwise. As you fly higher, you should see a platform with a giant golden cube where the Tear is.

Koboh - Fractured Power: From the Fogged Expanse meditation point, follow the straightforward path to the end of Marl Cavern (entered through Fogged Expanse) using the orange balloon grapple point to find this. You have to defeat all the enemies using the Crossguard Stance.

Coruscant - Fractured Malice: From the Rooftops meditation point, don’t proceed towards Renovation Site 4733. Instead, go the opposite linear way along the pipes and you’ll eventually be able to lift a door behind which is the Force Tear. You’ll have to kill two Rancors.

Jedha - Fractured Tradition: From the Monastery Walls meditation point, head left and make your way to the top of the hill until you can slide down. Grapple onto the ledge and then shimmy along the beam. Then, jump across the pillars to get to it. Here you have to defeat 1 wave of Bedlam Raider enemies using only the single lightsaber stance. Nothing too complex.
Jedha - Fractured Determination: From the Anchorite Base meditation point, open your map. Left of where you are are two green opened paths. In one of them is this Force Tear.

Jedha - Fractured Dexterity: From the Crypt of Uhrma meditation point, take up the stairs and then the new set of stairs in the small room with the two Stormtroopers. Now, wall-run into the windy area with the Scavenger Droid, and take a left.

Jedha - Fractured Cunning: From the Timeworn Bridge meditation point, go up the small room hill and get outside. Continue right and around the cliff, then squeeze through the crack. Now, go through the door on the left. Now climb up the wall and dash through the green laser door.

Shattered Moon - Fractured Endurance: From the Automated Forge meditation point, continue on until you eventually reach a room with two electrified climbable grates. Get to the very top of this room, then run along the wall. After the wall-run, don’t zip your way down the line, but instead swing across the nearby pole. You’ll have to kill 150 B1 Battle Droids.

There are 13 legendary enemies to dispatch, and they include creatures like the Rancor, Spawn of Oggdo, or Vile Bilemaw, as well as certain named humanoid foes and hostile droids. Each one will require a different strategy, as they’re some of the toughest opponents you’ll face in Jedi: Survivor. Track them all down and dispatch them to earn this one.

D-L1T (Coruscant > Hangar 2046-C): After the Meditation Point, head up the small lift and go through to the next corridor. To the left is a door that you can only open with BD-1’s Electro Dart. This legendary Security Droid is inside.
Frenzied Jotaz (Coruscant > Undercity Meats): You can hear this enemy trying to break down the heavy doors in this section. Use an Electro Dart to open the door and kill him.
Urgost, Fist of Rayvis (Koboh > Observatory Understructure): Automatically fought as a boss in Chapter 5 on your way to the top of the Mountain Observatory.

Gorocco Matriarch (Koboh > Derelict Dam): After the Meditation Point, take the right path at the fork and drop down to the destructible wall. Turn around and wall run across to the room with the Roller Mine, then kite it over to you and run back across the wall. Pull and Push it to break the wall, then go through and climb up the rope. Head around the ledge and use Lift to raise the door, then go through and fight this enemy.
Vile Bilemaw (Koboh > Fogged Expanse): In the circular section at the back of this area. Slide down the mudslide to reach it.
Rancor (Koboh > Sodden Grotto): Located at the end of Sodden Grotto. You’ll come to this area as you clear Koboh out for Treasures.
Golden Skriton (Jedha > Anchorite Base): From the Anchorite Base meditation point, go to the leftmost point in the Desert Ridge territory. Here you’ll find this creature.

The Mire Terror (Koboh > Viscid Bog): After going down the long lift to this area, look to the left and use Lift to raise three stone platforms and jump across to the area where this enemy is located.

Spawn of Oggdo (Koboh > Fort Kah’Lin): Move through the watchtowers until you reach the big circular platform, which will drop underneath you and into this battle. After you kill him you can open the chest for the Poncho and :bronze: A Presence I’ve Not Felt Since… .

Sutaban Alpha (Jedha > Crypt of Uhrma): From the Crypt of Uhrma Meditation Point, go up two flights of stairs. Now go through the door and jump-dash across the chasm on the right. Continue on and then downhill to enter the Crypt of Uhrma. Inside the Crypt, you’ll find a puzzle door. Number the switches in the first row 1-4, and the ones in the second row 5-8. Pull 1-4-6-7. Enter the secret area and you’ll eventually be able to dash through a green laser door. Continue on past the squeeze and you’ll find this enemy.

The Massiff (Koboh > Yurt Barracks): Above the huts in the barracks you’ll see The Massiff standing behind a window next to an Essence. To get there, you need to go underneath him, take a left out of the area with the huts, and then left again to see a grate you can climb. Turn around, Lift the door, and go through to fight it.
Beetu Deetu (Koboh > Southern Reach): From the Meditation Point, walk forwards and this enemy will drop in front of you.

E3-VE3 (Koboh > Untamed Downs): From the Bygone Settlement meditation point, open your map and ride a Nekko to the Untamed Downs region. Immediately after entering the region, flank the left side of the ridge until you can see an opening in the mountain on your left. Dash through the green laser door and you’ll eventually run into it.
Discover and complete all Jedi Chambers

There are seven Jedi Chambers to track down and complete. You’ll automatically visit the first one during the story, but you’ll need to find the other six yourself. There are three on Jedha and three on Koboh, and they’re pretty distinctive, with their gold, cube-shaped entrances and aperture-style doors. Find and complete all seven, and you’ll earn this trophy.

Chamber of Duality (Koboh > Rambler’s Reach > Rambler’s Reach Outpost): Unmissable, story-related. You will visit this Jedi Chamber shortly after entering the Smuggler’s Tunnel below the Cantina during Chapter 2.
Chamber of Detachment (Koboh > Prospector’s Folly > Mountain Ascent): Accessed from the same platform where you find Skoova and the Mee fish. Check Star Wars Jedi: Survivor All Fish Locations.
Chamber of Connection (Koboh > Viscid Bog): Ride the zipline across the swamp and then drop to another zipline running perpendicular to find this temple.
Chamber of Fortitude (Koboh > Rambler’s Reach > Southern Ridge): Firstly, gain access to the Corroded Silo by lifting the hatch on the roof, then work your way down and into the Chamber.
Chamber of Clarity (Koboh > Rambler’s Reach > Untamed Downs): At the very top of the hill, the northernmost point in the territory.
Chamber of Reason (Koboh > Forest Array > Basalt Rift): To get here, fast travel to the Rift Passage meditation point. Get back to the Basalt Rift and go downhill. Swing across to get to it.

Chamber of Ambidexterity (Koboh > Stone Spire > Devastated Settlement): Make your way to the Grand Courtyard Meditation Point. From one of the cliff sides here you can see a giant golden cube on a lower platform. Below this platform is a small hidden ledge with a Relter perched on it. Take mental note of this perch. Now, in this area are three big violet lasers. From the way you originally came from as part of the story, head to the second one, the one all the way to the left of the three main updrafts if facing them. Redirect the laser towards the above-mentioned ledge, making sure it hits the rock. Now get there by means of the Relter and use BD-1’s goo laser to carry the fire inside the room and burn the vines.

There are several characters you can enlist to join you at the Pyloon’s Saloon cantina on Koboh. Some of these you'll come across naturally during the main story, while the rest can be found through rumours on Koboh.

Pit Droid (Koboh > Gorge Crash Site): Located in the Gorge Crash Site area on Koboh. You will go through this area and meet him on your way to the Cantina during the early stages of Chapter 2. However, you won’t be able to recruit just yet because you don’t have the Lift ability. Lift is an unmissable, story-related ability first unlocked during Chapter 4. Once you have it, return here and lift the ship out of the tar pit, then talk to the Pit Droid to recruit him. This will also unlock :bronze: There Is No Try.
Mosey and Turgle (Koboh > Rambler’s Reach Outpost): Unmissable, story-related unlock. You will automatically recruit them during a cutscene taking place in front of the Cantina during Chapter 2.

Toa (Koboh > Basalt Rift): Located in the Basalt Rift area on Koboh. You will go through this area and meet her on your way to the Forest Array halfway through Chapter 2. She’s a green looking alien girl and hard to miss.
Caij (Koboh > Devastated Settlement): Unmissable, story-related unlock. You will automatically meet Caij as you enter the Stone Spires region as part of the story halfway through Chapter 3.

Bhima and Tulli (Koboh > Boiling Bluff): Located across the chasm on a rock found near the Boiling Bluff meditation point on Koboh. You will visit this area towards the end of Chapter 3, after flying a Relter through the updrafts in the Devastated Settlement territory, on your way back to the Mantis, but you can always come back here anytime after. When you get here, kill the Mogu and then speak to the NPCs. In the Cantina they will set up a table for the Holotactics minigame required for :silver: Gambler.

Pili Walde (Jedha > Blustery Mesa): During Chapter 4 on Jedha, you’ll eventually reach a room with lots of ivy growing on walls. In the same room is Pili Walde. Talking to her will automatically recruit her as your gardener for the Cantina’s rooftop garden. Pili Walde is instrumental in having more plots for your garden, allowing you to grow more plants and fully kitting out the garden for :bronze: Growth Spurt.

Skoova (Koboh > Foothill Falls): During Chapter 5, you’ll reach an area called Foothill Falls. You can find Skoova sitting on his fishing boat opposite a hut. Talk to him to recruit him and he will join the Cantina. Skoova is instrumental in finding all Fish across Jedha and Koboh.

Jawa (Koboh > Bygone Settlement): This can only be done after unlocking the story-related Air Dash and Upgraded Ascension Cable abilities. After unlocking both abilities, fast-travel to the Bygone Settlement Meditation Point on Koboh and complete the platforming challenge that starts with a wall-run on a sheet right next to the Meditation Point. The platforming challenge’s path is quite linear and at the end you’ll find the Jawa.

Ashe Javi and DD-EC (Koboh > Harvest Ridge): They’re found right in the middle of the Harvest Ridge territory on Koboh. For reference, they’re both near the red blocked path in this territory, below the red barn, near the big floor grid.

Zygg Soza and Wini Eres (Koboh > Viscid Bog): Located in a tent near the Viscid Bog Meditation Point. Talk to the pair and they will want you to recover a lost tablet. Exit the tent and look to your left to find a rocky spire with some rusty support on its side. Atop this structure is the tablet. To get to it, raise the platform from the bog and climb it up, then land on the Meditation Point platform and raise it again. Now you should be able to reach the spire with the tablet.

T-1N8 (Foothill Falls): Located in the downstairs section of the abandoned shack that leads you to Phon’Qi Caverns. To reach it, glide the Relter that you find pointing towards the area with the abandoned shack and use Pull open the trapdoor found on the left side of the shack.
Gain the attention of a mysterious stranger

Acquiring this will require completing all 17 Bounties, issued by Caij from the Pyloon’s Saloon cantina, having first met the bounty hunter during the story. Taking on each bounty will require a Bounty Puck from Caij, unless you happen to randomly run into a target (this happened to us more than once while exploring). Vanquish all 17 bounties and return the pucks to Caij, then head to the location in the Devastated Settlement marked on your map for one final battle..
Meyen Corr (Koboh > Boiling Bluff): On the path leading from Boiling Bluff to the Untamed Downs region.

Gatt Medo (Coruscant > Freight Handling Depot): From the Meditation Point, continue down below and you’ll eventually enter an area with overhead conveyor belts. Inside this room, guarded by two Haxion Brood Shock Commando, is this Bounty.
Mash (Shattered Moon > Automated Forge): From the Meditation Point, don’t enter the area with the Droid NPC, but the other one. Continue a bit further on and you’ll find this enemy.
Masi Finau (Nova Garon > Hangar Bay Exterior): When you return to Nova Garon for the collectible cleanup, you’ll find him in the Hangar Bay, together with two other Bounties.
Kle-0 (Nova Garon > Hangar Bay Exterior): When you return to Nova Garon for the collectible cleanup, you’ll find in the Hangar Bay, together with two other Bounties.
Fenn Finau (Nova Garon > Hangar Bay Exterior): When you return to Nova Garon for the collectible cleanup, you’ll find in the Hangar Bay, together with two other Bounties.
Corde The Half: (Jedha > Halls of Ranvell): From the Meditation Point, zip your way up the line left of the meditation point and you’ll find this Bounty atop the cliff.
PR-85T The Other Half: (Jedha > Halls of Ranvell): From the Meditation Point, zip your way up the line left of the Meditation Point and you’ll find this Bounty atop the cliff.
Yuhong: (Jedha > Anchorite Base): This Bounty is located in the Path of Restoration territory, all the way to the left of the Meditation Point, past the Desert Ridge territory.
Kip Ostar (Koboh > Derelict Dam): From the Meditation Point, head right and then make a U-Turn to enter an area with a Roller Mine. Continue past it and you’ll encounter him.
Raz (Koboh > Forest Array): Found in the Forest Array, close to where the big bird was during the story.
Selfin Jook (Koboh > Observatory Understructure): From the Meditation Point, climb up the grid, ride up the orange balloons and you’ll eventually run into him
Vaslyn Martz (Koboh > Fogged Expanse): Located near a Treasure. You’ll run into him as you clear out the territory.

Kili Oso (Jedha > Sepulcher Pass): This can only be tracked once all previous 14 Bounties have been eliminated. Once you have, go back to the Cantina and speak with Caij twice to have her track the target for you. Head to Jedha and get your bounty. For this particular Bounty, you can only fast travel as the Timeworn Bridge meditation point. You have to make the final stretch on foot.

Jo the Cannibal (Koboh > Yurt Barracks): This can only be tracked once you’ve killed all previous 15 Bounties. Once you have, go back to the Cantina and interact with Caij twice to have her track the target for you. Head to Yurt Barracks and get your bounty. For this particular Bounty, you can only fast travel as the Loading Gantry meditation point. You have to make the final stretch on foot.

Caij (Koboh > Devastated Settlement): This can only be tracked once you’ve eliminated all previous 16 Bounties. Once you have, return to the Cantina and interact with the tablet at the table Caij was sitting at. Now, meet her in the exact same spot you met her during the story at the Devastated Settlement in Stone Spires on Bodoh and talk to her. Complete the next step to earn this trophy.
Scan every type of enemy to fill out the Tactical Guide

On each occasion you defeat an enemy for the first time, you’ll be able to instruct BD-1 to scan them by pressing down on the d-pad when prompted. During the course of the story, you’ll be able to complete the majority of the Tactical Guide, but you’ll also need to complete Bounties for Caij, as each class of Haxion Brood also counts towards this. Same goes for legendary adversaries - you’ll have to scan some of those, too.
Shield Trooper (Koboh > Basalt Rift): right next to the Meditation Point, you’ll find one fighting a B1 Battle Droid together with a normal Stormtrooper.
Jetpack Trooper (Jedha > Halls of Ranvell): while traveling with Merrin, you’ll find this enemy type shortly before arriving at the oasis on your way to tame the Spamel creature.

Imperial Officer (Jedha > Whistling Drop): shortly after a windy section, you’ll drop into an area with some Stormtroopers fighting against a Skriton. You can find the corpse of an Imperial Officer by the fire. If you walk close to the fire, BD-1 will beep. If you haven’t scanned him during the story, you can find them on Jedha > Anchorite Base. Fast-travel here and destroy any of the roaming AT-AT. After destroying one, the Imperial Officer will crawl out.

Viper Probe Droid (Koboh > Alignment Control Center): you’ll find this enemy type as you head to the Arrays as part of Chapter 6. If you have not scanned it during the story, some can be found on Nova Garon > Central Command.
DT Sentry Droid (Jedha > Crypt of Uhrma): unmissable, story-related. You’ll encounter this enemy shortly after the Meditation Point together with two Stormtroopers.
Security Droid Enforcer (Nova Garon > Hangar Bay Exterior): shortly after the previous enemy, in a console room with various Stormtroopers, ISB Agents, and a black droid.

ISB Agent (Nova Garon > Hangar Bay Exterior): shortly after landing on Nova Garon as part of the story in Chapter 6, you’ll find this enemy type manning a console in a room you’ll have to enter to advance the story.
B1 Battle Droid (Koboh > Gorge Crash Site meditation point): this is the first enemy type you’ll encounter upon visiting Koboh for the first time as part of the main story.
B1 Melee Battle Droid (Koboh > Swindler’s Wash): you’ll automatically find this droid type on your way to the Forest Gate.

B2 Battle Droid (Koboh > Gorge Crash Site meditation point): shortly after, you’ll witness a small cliff explosion. In the same area of the explosion, before a wall you can run on, is a B2 Battle Droid.
BX Droid (Koboh > Derelict Dam): from the meditation point, continue along the main story path. This is found as soon as you enter the mines. You’ll have to scan this enemy after it’s dead.

BX Droid (Hybrid) (Koboh > Devastated Settlement): after meeting Caij towards the end of Chapter 3, climb up the vine behind her and glide the Relter. After landing, continue up the vine and enter the Jedi Chamber. You’ll find this new enemy type here.

BX Droid (Rifle) (Koboh > Southern Reach): from the Southern Reach meditation point, continue on and down the hill, past the tent until you get to a split. At the split, head right and you should eventually find three Gorgers. Next to the Gorgers location is a silo you can climb up at whose top is this enemy type.

Droideka (Koboh > Hangar Rafters): you will encounter this enemy during Chapter 4, objective “Rescue Zee from the Lucrehulk”. Eventually, you and Bode will split up. When you reunite, you will run into two Droideka.

E3-VE3 (Koboh > Untamed Downs): from the Bygone Settlement meditation point, open your map and ride a Nekko to the Untamed Downs region. Immediately after entering the region, flank the left side of the ridge until you can see an opening in the mountain on your left. Dash through the green laser door and you’ll eventually run into it.

The Massiff (Koboh > Yurt Barracks): above the huts in the barracks you’ll see The Massiff stood behind a window next to an Essence. To get there, you need to go underneath him, take a left out of the area with the huts, and then left again to see a grate you can climb. Turn around, Lift the door, and go through to fight it.
Bedlam Raider Lieutenant (Single-Blade): found in Koboh > Viscid Bog > Generator Underbelly.
Bedlam Raider Lieutenant (Double-Blade) (Koboh > Grand Courtyard): immediately after reaching the meditation point, squeeze through the crevice to find this enemy type.
Magnaguard (Shattered Moon > Automated Forge): found on the main story path shortly after landing on the Shattered Moon.
Bedlam Smasher: you will encounter this enemy on the main path, immediately before reuniting with Bode for the second time. Alternatively, it is found as you explore the Observatory in Chapter 5.
Beetu Deetu (Koboh > Southern Reach). From the Meditation Point, walk forwards and this enemy will drop in front of you.
Haxion Brood Commando (Shattered Moon > Automated Forge): from the Meditation Point, don’t enter the area with the Droid NPC, but the other one. Continue a bit further on and you’ll find this enemy.

Haxion Brood Shock Commando: (Coruscant > Freight Handling Depot): from the Meditation Point, continue down below and you’ll eventually enter an area with overhead conveyor belts. Inside this room, guarded by two Haxion Brood Shock Commando, is this target.

Haxion Brood Grenadier (Koboh > Devastated Settlement): towards the end of Chapter 3, while on your way to Research Tanalorr at Dagan’s Retreat on Koboh, you will be attacked by the Bounty Hunter Korej Lim. After killing him and the cutscene with Caij, scan his body.
Gorocco (Koboh > Derelict Dam): from the Derelict Dam meditation point, cross the bridge and you’ll find this creature above a ledge with two B1 Battle Droids trying to kill it.

Gorger (Koboh > Southern Reach): from the Southern Reach meditation point, continue on and down the hill, past the tent until you get to a split. Vile Bilemaw (Koboh > Fogged Expanse): in the circular section at the back of this area. Slide down the mudslide to reach it.

Gorocco Matriarch (Koboh > Derelict Dam): after the Meditation Point, take the right path at the fork and drop down to the destructible wall. Turn around and wall run across to the room with the Roller Mine, then kite it over to you and run back across the wall. Pull and Push it to break the wall, then go through and climb up the rope. The Mire Terror (Koboh > Viscid Bog): after going down the long lift to this area, look to the left and use Lift to raise three stone platforms and jump across to the area where this enemy is located.

Rancor (Coruscant > Rooftops): you’ll be able to fight two Rancors after interacting with the Force Tear on Coruscant > Rooftops. Check All Force Tear Locations. Alternatively, this is found in the Sodden Grotto underground area on Koboh.
Bilemaw (Koboh > Basalt Rift): you’ll find it rampaging from a cave and over two Stormtroopers. This is an unmissable, story-related event during Chapter 2 in the Forest Array region.
Rawka (Koboh > Swindler’s Wash): shortly before entering the Forest Array region as part of Chapter 2. Hard to miss.

Spawn of Oggdo (Koboh > Fort Kah’Lin): get to the Untamed Downs region and then make your way to Fort Kah’Lin. Grapple to the rooftops until you reach an area defended by several Battle B1 Droids. As soon as you reach them, you’ll automatically drop down to the boss’s arena.
Bramlik (Koboh > Devastated Settlement): immediately after meeting Caij during Chapter 3. Climb the vine behind her and you’ll find this new enemy type on the cliff.

Shiverpede: (Koboh > George Crash Site): from the meditation point, facing the elevator, go left where the puddles of water are. You’ll find this opposite a climbable wall, well-camouflaged in the environment.
Mogu (Koboh > Basalt Rift): after meeting with Toa, continue on and up the hill with the collapsed pillars. At the top of the hill, to your left, you’ll find this creature.
Hardshell (Jedha > near the Mantis): as soon as you get to Jedha as part of the story in Chapter 3, you’ll find this on one of the ledges near the Mantis.
Golden Skriton (Jedha > Anchorite Base): from the Anchorite Base meditation point, go to the leftmost point in the Desert Ridge territory. Here you’ll find this creature.
Sutaban (Jedha > Monastery Walls): inside the broken structure to the left of the Meditation Point.

Sutaban Alpha (Jedha > Crypt of Uhrma): from the Crypt of Uhrma meditation point, go up the stairs and up the stairs again. Now through the door and jump-dash across the chasm on the right.
