Enter the secret area and you’ll eventually be able to dash through a green laser door. Continue on past the squeeze and you’ll find this enemy.

Roller Mine: (Koboh > Derelict Dam): from the Derelict Dam meditation point, continue opposite the bridge until you can climb up some vines. Continue along the main path until you see two droids. Next to them is a Roller Mine.

Scavenger Droid (Koboh > Southern Reach): from the Southern Reach meditation point, continue on and down the hill, past the tent until you get to a split. At the split, head right and you should eventually find three Gorgers. Next to the Gorgers’ location is a silo behind which is a Scavenger Droid. If you kill it, it will drop a Data Disc or Priorite Shard. Another one can be found next to the Swindler’s Wash meditation point as you make your way to the Forest Array region. Don’t stress too much if you can’t kill one on your first try. You’ll eventually have to as they’re part of the planets’ collectible cleanups. If they burrow, reset the area at the nearest Meditation Point.

Upon unlocking perks, you’ll be given three perk slots. You might slot in three perks and think ‘job done’. It’s not. You need to obtain additional perk slots first. You can purchase one from Zee’s store in Pyloon’s Saloon for 10 Datadiscs, while another six need to be tracked down. That’s a total of ten slots, and you’ll need to find Essence points to acquire them. When you’ve completed all seven Jedi Chambers, travel to the Alignment Control Center (you’ll unlock this Meditation Point towards the end of the story), and use BD-1 to slice the terminal, checking that all seven monitors have turned green. This will enable you to locate the Essence locations required to unlock the remaining Perk slots. Slot enough Perks at a Meditation Point to fill all ten slots once you’ve acquired all ten, and this will unlock.

Perk Slot (Jedha > Path of Restoration): awarded for completing the Path of Restoration puzzle. You will automatically earn this Perk Slot as you work your way to obtain the Map Upgrades for the location of all Treasures.

Perk Slot (Jedha > Path of Persistence): awarded for completing Path of Persistence puzzle. You will automatically earn this Perk Slot as you work your way to obtain the Map Upgrades for the location of all Treasures.

Perk Slot (Jedha > Path of Conviction): awarded for completing Path of Conviction puzzle. You will automatically earn this Perk Slot as you work your way to obtain the Map Upgrades for the location of all Treasures.

Perk Slot: Derelict Dam (Koboh > Derelict Dam): you can only obtain this when you get the Slam power in Chapter 4. From the Meditation Point, go forwards and cross the tar pit and climb up the vines. To the left, opposite the huge creature, is a yellow platform which you can lower with Slam (press :r1: and :cross: . Keep heading forwards past the floating yellow barge on the left until you reach a cave at the end. Pull the sphere to you, then use Push to throw it onto the barge, then again to throw it into the emitter, which will burn away the Koboh Dust opposite. Head over there and Slice the machine to release a Roller Mine. Keep kiting it closer to you, jump up the ledge and out of the cave and keep getting the Mine to follow you until you get close to the destructible wall, then Pull and Push it so that it blows up the wall. Go through, look to the left and use BD-1’s Koboh Grinder to burn away the Koboh Dust, then wall run and climb up. Go outside to find this Perk Slot.
Perk Slot (Koboh > Harvest Ridge): can be found after solving the Nekko puzzle. You will encounter this automatically as you work on :bronze: King of the World.

Perk Slot (Koboh > Smuggler’s Tunnel): this Perk Slot is found behind the red blocked door in Smuggler’s Tunnel. The only way to reach this location is by first unlocking Harvest Ridge meditation point. Then, from here use the Relter perched on top of the cliffs in the area and to glide towards the Cantina. In the Cantina area, look for a building with an open side rooftop by the water. In here, dash through the green laser door, drop down and make your way through the linear path.
Collect the final Perk Slot: this can be bought at Zee’s Shop on the Cantina’s second floor for 10 Data Discs.
To slot Perks in the Slots, head for Essence locations and you will soon find enough to fill all 10 Slots.
